scope: Versioned no-behavior reconciliation for the pre-existing RTL2.0c opaque delivery-context and RTL2.0d typed endpoint contracts. It corrects one historical future-phase annotation without rewriting a historical artifact. It does not activate Chisel behavior, payload movement, endpoint storage, R2 scheduling, controller behavior, timing, throughput, PPA, model/GPU work, or a new A4 DSE.

historical_annotation_correction.reason: RTL2.1 activated only pack_write and descriptor-maintenance durability/publication behavior; read-fragment delivery remains the explicit RTL2.2 scope.

owner_freeze.top_rule: route_a_kv_subsystem_top composes owner-produced carriers and must not allocate contexts, decode opaque refs, construct target descriptors, select an ingress, or manufacture a terminal.

typed_read_fragment.rule: Registry validation precedes endpoint observation; unknown, stale, duplicate, wrong-class, or wrong-generation delivery has no endpoint mutation.

typed_write_terminal.rule: Write terminals are distinct from read fragments and retain the RTL2.1 exact-owner completion rules.

scoreboard_binding.rule: A later adapter may emit only an R2-delivered, registry-validated architectural event; it may not infer delivery from arbitrary internal state.

must_remain_deferred: P3/S2/direct functional payload storage or transport deposit
four-consumer GQA completion and source release
physical SRAM macro, port count, controller, clock, timing, throughput, energy, area, or PPA interpretation
evidence_labels: pure-software machine-readable provenance and interface contract
